draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package reports only exp1 (original labels, 5 seeds). No perturbation/label-noise condition, no robustness criterion applied, and no statistical tests are reported. The claim about robustness to label noise has no evidentiary support.
